rung: FR-6 items 1 and 3, acceptance A5'' (numerical verification, D174's first claim kind; no biological comparison, D151)
question: Does species_regulated_availability@1 drive each of two cells' gate-free K-leak populations through that cell's own regulatory state s1 (hill_regulated_two_state@1, read from the cell's X by a Hill activation, X under D150's turnover, the same dose in both cells), from a per-cell prior s0 = 0.1 in a and 0.8 in b, so that V and the amounts of both cells converge at second order to R-cell with the state integrated alongside; and are the two cells told apart: a swapped, shared or ignored prior, the state bypassed, the state's rates 1% off and the basal level x (1 + delta) each caught?
engine_models: resolved_pump_composite@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3 (the composite and its inner model)

species_regulated_availability@1 with hill_regulated_two_state@1 (the state s1) and two state_fraction couplings on the channel targets, its step exact_two_state_half_steps@1 (the operator judged; FR-6 items 1 and 3)
scheduled_species_turnover@1 (X, D150's regulator), its step exact_production_clearance_half_steps@1
kleak_always_open@1 (the populations), constant_field@1 (the patches), the closure resolved_capacitor_components_current_continuity@1 with capacitive_reduction_gauged_damped_newton@2
the IDs the judged definitions print are recorded by the generator and checked against this list
scope: Two identical pump-free 2 pL cells, a and b, each on one constant-field 4 pF patch facing a bath held at 0 V, with a gate-free K-leak population of 2e-9 m/s; X in each cell held at 1 uM by D150's turnover (clearance 5/s) and driven toward 10 uM over [0.2, 0.5) s, the same dose in both; s1 in both cells (Hill activation of X, K 3 uM, n 2; k_on 5/s, k_off 1/s), s0 = 0.1 in a and 0.8 in b; F = 0.1 + 0.9 s1 on each population; 2 s on the ladder 1, 0.5, 0.25 and 0.125 ms; CPU only. Synthetic, within A5's bracket (the references' README). Not covered: A5' (gated channels), the routing door (FR-6 item 2, the core pass's seam B1), leak and pump targets, any biological comparison

budgets.status: declared 18 November 2026 by the FR owner, before any engine output compared with the references (one well-posedness run, no comparison: disclosures); for the lead's ruling (questions_for_the_lead)
budgets.orders: A5's rule, the coupling protocol's resolved-pair rule (imported read-only): V and the amounts of both cells, the max norm of each rung's error against R-cell over the records; a pair of successive rungs is resolved when its finer error is at least 100 x the reference's floor and its rounding scale; every resolved pair's order in [1.7, 2.3]; at least (the development count - 1) resolved pairs per observable, the count fixed by the development run and disclosed (the coupling protocol's form). s, U, F and a_eff reported
budgets.start: row 0 equal to the references' registered start (V, the amounts and s) within 1e-15 relative (a priori: both sides start from it)
budgets.state_budget: reported, not judged (the lead's ruling 1; derived from the references' stand-in, disclosed): B_V(dt) = 1e-6 V (dt / 1 ms)^2 and B_n(dt) = 3e-8 fmol (dt / 1 ms)^2 for V and the amounts of both cells at every record of every rung. It is the registered honest stand-in's errors rounded up (6.6e-7 V and 2.1e-8 fmol at 1 ms, at second order), not a closed form of declared values: the stand-in sits at 0.64 to 0.71 of it on every rung. Every registered control departs by at least 10 x it at 1 ms: the prior's by 2.9e3 x to 6.1e3 x in V (2.0e4 x to 4.3e4 x in the amounts), the bypass 5.4e3 x, k_on and k_off 24 x in V and 560 x in the amounts, the basal x (1 + 1e-3) 16.8 x in the amounts only (1.0 x in V)
budgets.delta: the basal control's delta, by the coupling protocol's rule, declared now and registered after the development run (disclosed): the delta whose control's V departure plateaus at 10 x the development run's finest (0.125 ms) V error, rounded up on a 1-2-5 grid. Judged: at the registered delta the control puts a resolved pair of V or the amounts out of the band (the rule can fail)
budgets.controls_margin: the lead's ruling 1: each control's departure from the references (the max norm over the records against R-cell's registered world) at least 10 x the honest engine's own error at the same rung (the registered world's run at that rung against the same reference), in each observable where the references show power: V and the amounts for the prior, the bypass and the rates, on all four rungs; the two basal controls as the lead's ruling 6 sets them (criteria)

questions_answered: 1. The controls' scale (the lead, 18 November 2026): (b) is judged and (a) is reported. Every control's departure from the references must be at least 10 x the honest engine's own error at the same rung, in each observable where the references show power: V and the amounts for the prior, bypass and rate controls; the basal control in the amounts at every rung, and in V only at the rungs where the references show power. Accuracy comes from the resolved-pair order rule, as for A5: orders in [1.7, 2.3], with the resolved counts; a wrong limit breaks convergence there. (a) is not judged because a budget made by rounding up the references' stand-in could fail an honest second-order engine on its error constant alone; its comparison is reported, disclosed as derived from the stand-in
2. delta by the coupling protocol's rule (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed. The rule is declared now; the number comes after the development run and is disclosed before registration
3. Every control on all four rungs, about 36 short runs (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed

4. D188's move 2 (the lead, 18 November 2026): it cannot start until OL1 lands, which waits for the user's go this morning. If A5'' is ready before then, it rehearses and registers on the current, pre-move main, with FR-3 first; otherwise it registers after move 2, on the moved tree. The lead is told when either proposal is near
5. The resolved-pair counts as the coupling protocol sets them (the lead, 18 November 2026): confirmed; its rule imported read-only

6. The basal control under rulings 1 and 2 (the lead, 18 November 2026): (iii), both basal controls, which reconciles the two rulings. K_basal_rule, at the coupling protocol's delta (its V departure 10 x the finest V error): judged by its own detection, a resolved pair outside the band, and by rule (b) only where it has power, the amounts at 0.25 and 0.125 ms and V at 0.125 ms. K_basal_reference, at the references' registered delta = 1e-3: judged by rule (b) in the amounts at every rung and in V at 0.25 and 0.125 ms. The conflict is disclosed: at the rule's delta the control's margin over the honest error is 10 (0.125 / dt)^2 in V, 0.16, 0.6, 2.5 and 10 at 1, 0.5, 0.25 and 0.125 ms, and about 2.4, 9.8, 39 and 156 in the amounts on the stand-in's ratios; ruling 1's 'the amounts at every rung' refers to the references' delta
